description: This file is a script intended for code analysis and auditing within a larger repository. It includes functions for traversing source files, parsing TypeScript, identifying project-specific import patterns, and generating an inventory of seams and related data for validation purposes. It exports functions to analyze source code, build various reports, and output JSON data summarizing code structure and cross-file dependencies.

methods.name: describeSeamKinds
methods.description: Determines the types of seams present in a source file based on its path and content, including specialized handling for cron and subagent related files.

methods.name: determineSeamTestStatus
methods.description: Evaluates if a seam has corresponding nearby test files and assigns status accordingly.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Orchestrates the analysis process; parses command line arguments, collects source files, generates inventory reports, and outputs JSON summary.
